scope: Source-free transport feasibility only; not evidence isolation attestation, architecture comparison or source quality.

application_invocations.conditional_diagnostic: Only after the initial attempt returned a known-usage failure that the predeclared same transport can diagnose without changing frozen code, settings, prompt or schema. Never after success, unknown usage, timeout without usage, forbidden tool activity, token/time stop or contamination. Any necessary code change requires a separately versioned plan within the remaining overall budget; this plan grants no implicit replacement attempt.

expected_mechanical_outcomes: Persist started request, exact prompt/schema, effective arguments and raw stdout/stderr before retaining terminal result.
One completed structured response equals the exact expected ack, with known nonnegative input/output token usage and actual elapsed time.
No tool or unknown event; any forbidden or unfamiliar event fails and invalidates the isolation claim.
An unsuccessful attempt is retained; no automatic retry and no substitution of output.
Unknown usage stops every further application call in this small trial until a new bounded plan resolves accounting.
Exactly one turn.completed reports both integer nonnegative input_tokens and output_tokens; exit status is zero.

budgets.overshoot_policy: One-call token overshoot is possible because no backend per-call output cap/input-token admission proof is available. Record actual overshoot and stop. Process cancellation can leave usage unknown. Cleanup grace is separately recorded.

runner_freeze_required.meaning: Root freezes these in a separate execution capsule before dispatch; null is a blocking unknown, not a wildcard.

stop_rules: Do not dispatch if any required runner freeze value remains null.
Stop on unknown application usage, stage/run budget exhaustion, forbidden tool activity or changed frozen artifacts.
Record failed/unused/pending slots explicitly; unused diagnostic is not a transferable spare call.
Do not launch source-bearing candidate calls until preventive isolation is independently reviewed and attested.
